reviews.author: Devadesát Dva
reviews.text: Aaron jakožto chinese-aussie je už od pohledu kombo, ale jede si svůj low-slow style s rukou v kapse, je to sympatický, ale zároveň jsou to takový one-liners, kde se toho moc neřekne ani neděje, což se mi asi aktuálně hodilo, protože to dost uteklo a nevyžadovalo mozek... tu a tam slušnej joke. Myslím si ale, že by měl trochu zapracovat a vytunit některý aspekty, naučit se víc prodat svůj materiál, například absolutně brutálně vypulírovanou formou mě dostáváRed Richardson - Bugatti Live, což je za poslední roky stand-up, co se mi líbil snad nejvíc. (…) "My dad, he moved from China to Australia to give us a better life. I moved to America to make it worse again." (...) (drinks water from a vase with flowers) "...but my life's not going well" (…) "...he said, this is the most creative player we've ever seen. He's like a book with hundreds of pages and every page is different. I'm like, thats every book. If your book has the same pages, I'd say your book is broken. you know?" (...) "The other day, she said to me, can you pass the toner? And I was like, we don't have a printer." (...) "We went to the opera together. We went, I struggled, I must admit. She'S like why are you closing your eyes? I'm like, I'm really into it. But I think you were snoring. I was like, I was singing along." (...) "...And she was furious at me. She was like, why didn't you tell me that wrestling was fake? And I was like, I wouldn't know where to begin. Like do you know that cavemen aren't around?"(03.04.2026)
